summary: A 0.8 m four-legged inspection robot: a chamfered chassis with a dark top deck, payload rail and spinning lid… joints lidar, head, hip_fl, knee_fl, hip_fr, knee_fr, …; options shell; sockets socket_payload, eye.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.robot_dog or place "prefab": "robot_dog" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
